# Abundantics

> Abundantics is a post-scarcity social science research framework. This website is its official research portal.

## What is TEPI?

TEPI (Token Energy Parity Index) is a daily-updated index measuring the energy-token parity in AI compute economics. It consists of four sub-indices:

- **R_M**: Mining energy cost per kWh (USD/kWh)
- **R_A**: AI inference energy cost per kWh (USD/kWh)
- **Lambda (Λ)**: Energy-parity ratio (dimensionless) — the core index
- **Omega (Ω)**: Abundance multiplier (dimensionless)

## JSON API

All data is available as static JSON/CSV — no authentication, no rate limits.

- Latest index: `https://abundantics.org/api/parity/latest.json`
- Full history: `https://abundantics.org/api/parity/history.csv`
- Methodology: https://abundantics.org/en/index/methodology/

### latest.json schema

```json
{
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "method_version": "0.1",
  "date": "2026-08-19",
  "generated_at": "2026-08-19T00:40:00Z",
  "indices": {
    "R_M":    { "value": 0.066, "unit": "USD/kWh",       "change_1d": 0.002 },
    "R_A":    { "value": 15.41, "unit": "USD/kWh",       "change_1d": null },
    "Lambda": { "value": 233.9, "unit": "dimensionless", "change_1d": -0.4 },
    "Omega":  { "value": 5.74,  "unit": "dimensionless", "change_1d": 0.1 }
  },
  "sources": ["tanghuidao/token-parity"],
  "license": "CC-BY-4.0"
}
```

### history.csv columns

`date, R_M, R_A, Lambda, Omega, Lambda_chained, method_version`
